question: The volume of a right circular cone is 924 cm³ and its height is 18 cm. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the base of the cone? (Take π = {(22)/(7)})
solution:
**Given:- **

Volume of right circular cone = 924 cm³

Height of cone = 18 cm

**Formula used :-**

Volume of Cone =** **1/3(π r²h)

Perimeter of cone Base = 2π r

where,

r = radius of cone base

h = height of cone

**Calculation:- **

According to question:-

⇒ 1/3(π r²h) = 924

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × r² × 18 = 924

⇒ r² = (924 × 7 × 3)/(22 × 18)

⇒ r² = 19404/396

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = 7 cm

∴ Perimeter of cone base = 2π r

P = 2 × (22/7) × 7

P = 2 × 22

P = **44 cm**

**∴The perimeter of base of cone is 44cm**
